messages:
Maya: Heads-up — saw a 3.2x spike in telemetry ingest over the last hour. Traced it to fanout logging in routing-proxy where we log full req/resp pre-scrub. Example tenant=acme-prod route=/v1/embeddings payload ~9MB each
Samir: Ack. Do we have a trace id or an example message?
Maya: Added trace id to the thread. PR 4507 shows proxy writes raw payload to kafka topic analytics.raw-requests before any redaction. Suspect backpressure + quota burn.
Devin: That's the fanout pattern we talked about. Quick mitigation: flip proxy to `log-pointer` mode — write small metadata + pointer, store raw blob in ephemeral-store with strict TTL & KMS. Keeps analytics payloads small.
Liz: Pointer mode still risky — raw blob could contain PII. We should scrub server-side before inserting into any store. Proposal: scrub -> pseudonymize -> pointer.
Jorge: Scrub latency is the hang-up. Embeddings route has high throughput; we can’t add >30ms p95. Maybe do async scrub: log pointer immediately, scrub in background, then replace blob and mark redact_state. Console shows "pending-scrub" until done.
Maya: Quick config sketch I put together:
```
logging:
  mode: pointer            # pointer | metadata_only | raw
  pointer_store: ephemeral-kv
  scrub_policy: per-route  # route-specific rules (embeddings/chat)
  scrub_async: true
  redact_policy: [hash-email, mask-ssn, remove-creditcard]
  quota_aware_sample:
    baseline: 0.05         # global baseline sample rate
    per_tenant_max: 0.2    # allow higher for paying tenants
```
Anya: +1 on per-route scrub rules. Also want a quota-aware sampler that throttles telemetry from noisy tenants so platform teams don't lose observability. Tie sample token -> billing tier.
Devin: Console UX thought: add a "scrub status" column on Request Logs with filter for pending/redacted/raw and a toggle for "show raw (audit only)" gated by role + tenant consent. Only show for tenants with audit_consent=true.
Maya: Operational mitigation: will flip routing-proxy to `metadata_only` in us-west-2 canary (5% rollout) to stop raw fanout. Opening PR now.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled to canary cluster at 02:15 UTC by @deploy-bot :rocket:
Jorge: Another option — do ingress redaction in a wasm plugin inside the proxy, then fanout sanitized copies. Avoids background jobs, but need perf numbers.
Samir: Ran a microbenchmark last night. Wasm redact adds ~4-6ms on 4k token payloads, but for embeddings/batched payloads it scales worse. Need a focused perf run for 1k-10k token batches.
Devin: Proposed plan: short-term disable raw fanout; mid-term implement ingress-wasm scrub + per-route async scrub + pointer store; long-term add quota-aware adaptive sampling + console transparency + per-tenant consent flags.
Liz: Also add an alert when raw-blob size > 1MB (or when raw-requests topic has >100MB/min) so we catch regressions fast.
Maya: Created issue #7882 with attached traces and the tentative config. I'll include the PR link shortly. Tagging @legal for consent implications: @legal-bot?
legal-bot: FYI — policy reminder: capture consent_state in metadata and ensure raw artifacts are encrypted and access-logged. Legal will review #7882 and PRs that change storage/retention.
Devin: One more UX detail — per-route scrub_policy should surface in the console docs and UI: explain what fields are scrubbed (emails, phones, names) so SREs and customers understand sampling artifacts.
Anya: Agree. For telemetry quotas, we should expose a per-tenant "telemetry budget" metric in console and allow ops to request temporary bursts (audit mode) with a TTL.
Jorge: If we go wasm-ingress, we'll need a feature flag and a canary perf harness. I can prototype a tiny wasm filter this week.
Maya: Thanks all. Short checklist:
- [ ] Flip to metadata_only canary (Maya)
- [ ] Create perf matrix for wasm redaction (Jorge + Samir)
- [ ] Add alert for oversized raw blobs (Liz)
- [ ] Draft console scrub-status UX + consent gating (Devin + Anya)
- [ ] Legal review for retention/consent (Legal)

Maya: Also :thumbsup: if you agree with the short-term mitigation so I can merge the canary PR.
Samir: :thumbsup:
Devin: :thumbsup:
Liz: :thumbsup:
Jorge: :thumbsup:

Maya: I'll post PR link once green. Thanks everyone.
